name: Ashened to Endlessness
card_text: During the Main Phase: You can Fusion Summon 1 Pyro Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck using monsters from either field, including "Veidos the Eruption Dragon of Extinction", and if you do, it gains 500 ATK for each material used.
